{{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Water| type2=Ice| ball=None| trainername=Ash| pokemonname=Lapras| jtrainername=サトシ| jpokemonname=ラプラス| tmtrainername=Satoshi| tmpokemonname=Laplace| image=[[File:Ash Lapras.png|250px]] | caption=Ash's Lapras | location=[[Tangelo Island]] | prevonum=131| epnum=EP084| epname=The Lost Lapras| released=yes| releaseep=EP113| releasename=Viva Las Lapras| current=With [[Lapras herd|its herd]]| noevo=incap | java1=[[Rikako Aikawa]]| }} '''Ash's Lapras''' (Japanese: '''サトシのラプラス''' ''Satoshi's Laplace'') was the first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} {{pkmn2|caught}} by {{Ash}} in the [[Orange Islands]], and his thirteenth overall. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|OS}}==== [[File:EP084.png|thumb|left|220px|Lapras being abused]] Ash first met Lapras in ''[[EP084|The Lost Lapras]]''. It had become separated from [[Lapras herd|its family]] and washed onto the shores of [[Tangelo Island]], where it was being abused by [[Three punks|three boys]]. {{AP|Pikachu}}'s {{m|Thunder Shock}} quickly sent the trio running. {{Tracey}} examined Lapras and realized it needed help. He gave Ash some medicine for it, but Lapras refused to take it. Afterwards, they took Lapras to the local [[Pokémon Center]], where [[Nurse Joy]] explained that Lapras was afraid of [[human]]s. Soon, Ash gained Lapras's trust after he saved it from {{TRT}}. Lapras later decided to become a part of Ash's [[party|team]] after Ash promised to reunite it with its family. Lapras was used extensively as a means of transportation, with Ash, {{an|Misty}}, and Tracey often crossing the seas between the [[Orange Islands]] on its back. In ''[[EP085|Fit To Be Tide]]'', Ash rode on Lapras during a wave ride race against [[Cissy]] and her {{p|Blastoise}} at the [[Mikan Gym]]. Thanks to Lapras using its Ice Beam to create an icy track to slide on, Ash won the race and earned his first [[Orange League]] [[Badge]]. In ''[[EP093|Navel Maneuvers]]'', Ash used Lapras against [[Danny]] when competing for his second Orange League Badge at the [[Navel Gym]]. It had to use Ice Beam to freeze a geyser, but it lost to Danny's {{p|Nidoqueen}}. [[File:EP111.png|thumb|220px|Lapras vs Gengar]] In ''[[EP111|Hello, Pummelo!]]'', Lapras was used in Ash's [[Full Battle]] against {{OBP|Drake|Orange League}}, going up against his {{p|Gengar}}. The episode concluded with a collision between Lapras's Ice Beam and Gengar's {{m|Night Shade}}, creating a big explosion. In ''[[EP112|Enter The Dragonite]]'', both Pokémon were revealed to have fainted simultaneously as a result. After Ash won the battle, Lapras was entered into the Orange League [[Hall of Fame]] with Ash's other Pokémon. In ''[[EP113|Viva Las Lapras]]'', Ash and {{ashfr}} found the herd that Lapras had become separated from. However, its school wanted nothing to do with Lapras, as humans accompanied it. They gained a hatred towards humans because of [[Captain Crook]], who hunted the Lapras. After Ash and his Lapras defeated the Captain's {{p|Tentacruel}}, the Lapras began to trust humans, and Ash's Lapras was able to rejoin the school, as well as its mother, tearfully parting ways with Ash in the process. ===={{aniseries|GS}}==== Ash was briefly reunited with Lapras at the [[Marine Pokémon Laboratory]] in ''[[EP257|Lapras of Luxury]]'', where it was revealed to have {{pkmn|aging|matured into an adult}}. Ash spent some time with Lapras the following night, during which he also helped to save its herd from Team Rocket. Having witnessed Ash's Lapras help saving them, the original leader of the herd stepped down and let Ash's Lapras take the lead as the herd resumed its migration away from [[Johto]]. ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== [[File:Ash Kanto Pokémon JN132 2.png|thumb|250px|left|Lapras encouraging Pikachu in a vision]] In ''[[JN132|Partners in Time!]]'', Lapras appeared as a vision to Pikachu during his battle against [[Leon's Charizard]]. In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Lapras appeared in a fantasy while Ash reminisced about the Pokémon he'd caught on his journey. In ''[[JN143|Ride, Lapras, Ride!]]'', Lapras was reunited with Ash when it sought his help in freeing a trapped {{p|Wailmer}}. Despite Wailmer evolving into a {{p|Wailord}} and getting stuck again, they were able to free the {{pkmn|category|Float Whale Pokémon}}. In the process, however, Ash ended up getting stuck in a cave as the tide began to rise. Working with Wailord, Lapras froze the water while Wailord carved a path through it with {{m|Weather Ball}}. Lapras then slid through to find Ash and bring him back to safety. With everyone now secure, Lapras said its goodbyes to the group and returned to its herd. {{-}} ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:EP113.png|thumb|220px|left|Lapras and its mother]] [[File:Ash and Lapras.png|thumb|250px|Lapras and Ash]] Lapras was particularly afraid of all humans, namely because of the actions of [[Three punks|three boys]] who quickly attacked it after it washed up on [[Tangelo Island]]. {{Ash}} and Lapras quickly formed a strong bond after Ash saved it from {{TRT}} in ''[[EP084|The Lost Lapras]]''. Lapras's speed was critical to Ash's success during his [[Orange League]] campaign, as it was used in half of his [[Gym]] challenges. It is an empathetic and reliable Pokémon who gained confidence during its time with Ash. Its more playful personality outshone its initial shyness. Lapras was hesitant to rejoin [[Lapras herd|its family]] in ''[[EP113|Viva Las Lapras]]'', though Ash convinced it to do so. When Lapras later appeared in [[Johto]], it was shown to have grown more mature, eventually even taking the leadership of its herd after helping to defeat Team Rocket and save the other Lapras they had stolen. {{-}} ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{water color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{water color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{ice color light}}; {{roundytl|5px}}" | As a child |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Ash Lapras young.png|250px]] |} ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|water|ice|Ash Lapras {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Ice Beam|1=Water Gun}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 2}}|0=Ice Beam|1=Water Gun}}}} {{anmov|ice|Ice Beam|EP085|Fit To Be Tide}} {{anmov|water|Water Gun|EP111|Hello, Pummelo!}} {{anmov/f|ice}} ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{ice color dark}}; background: #{{water color}}; font-size:80%;" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{water color dark}}; background: #{{ice color light}}" | [[File:To Be a Pokémon Master poster.png|x250px]] | style="{{roundy|5px}} border: 2px solid #{{water color dark}}; background: #{{ice color light}}" | [[File:JN143 AS.png|200px]] |- | Poster for
''{{color2|000|S25|Pokémon: To Be a Pokémon Master}}'' | Artwork from "After the story"https://twitter.com/anipoke_PR/status/1629722931101310976 |} ==In the manga== [[File:Ash Lapras EToP.png|thumb|180px|Lapras in [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]]]] ===The Electric Tale of Pikachu=== [[Ash Ketchum (EToP)|Ash]] encountered Lapras on [[Valencia Island]] in ''[[ET14|The Orange Islands]]'', where {{AP|Pikachu|Pikachu (EToP)}} found it being attacked by a group of {{p|Krabby}}. After Ash had managed to get rid of the Krabby with his {{AP|Squirtle}}, Pikachu was able to convince Lapras to go into a {{i|Poké Ball}}, allowing Ash to take it to a [[Pokémon Center]]. While Lapras was being healed, Ash learned that Lapras had gotten separated from its herd. As such, once the healing was complete, he decided to take care of Lapras, with Pikachu convincing the {{pkmn|category|Transport Pokémon}} that Ash was worthy of its trust. Since then, Ash used Lapras to transport himself from Orange Island to another. Lapras also took part in Ash's dance battle with [[Rudy]] in ''[[ET16|You Bet Your Wife]]'' and his battle against {{OBP|Drake|Orange League}} in ''[[ET18|Pikachu's Plan]]''. {{-}} ==Trivia== [[File:Lapras aging.png|thumb|220px|Comparison between Lapras's younger and older appearances]] * Lapras is the first {{type|Ice}} Pokémon owned by {{Ash}}. * Lapras is Ash's only Pokémon: ** [[List of Pokémon by shape#Pokémon with fins|With fins]]. ** To be consistently used as a means of transportation. * Out of all Pokémon to have been {{pkmn2|released}} by Ash, Lapras is: ** The only one to not be part of an evolutionary line. ** The first to have reunited with Ash, as well as the only one to have done so in more than one [[series]]. * Lapras is tied with {{AP|Muk}} for having used the least amount of [[move]]s out of any Pokémon that Ash has owned for longer than one episode, at two. * Lapras is the only non-temporary Pokémon caught by Ash during the [[original series]] to have not used a {{type|Normal}} move. * In ''[[EP257|Lapras of Luxury]]'', Lapras was shown to have matured since it was {{pkmn2|released}} in ''[[EP113|Viva Las Lapras]]'', to the point of Ash initially not recognizing it when they reunited. As such, Lapras is the only character to have been shown indisputably {{pkmn|aging}} during {{aniseries|PTS}}'s time frame. * Lapras made a cameo appearance in the tenth Japanese opening theme, [[Spurt!]]. However, it did not return in any episodes aired with the opening. ==References== ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Lapras}} * [[Lapras herd]] {{Ash's Pokémon|water|ice}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Ash's Pokémon|Lapras]] [[Category:Released Pokémon]] [[Category:Electric Tale of Pikachu characters]] [[de:Ashs Lapras]] [[es:Lapras de Ash]] [[fr:Lokhlass de Sacha]] [[it:Lapras di Ash]] [[ja:サトシのラプラス]] [[zh:小智的拉普拉斯]]
